LESSON: NUMBER RECOGNITION

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / PP1
Subject: General
Strand: NUMBERS
Topic 2.2: Number recognition
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 10

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Number recognition, part of NUMBERS in SNE  /  visual-impairment / PP1 General.

Key inquiry question: Why do we identify numbers? 2. How do you arrange numbers?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Number recognition together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and collaboration: Speaking: The Learner communicates clearly while talking to and listening to each other they

play number recognition games in groups or pairs.

Values:
• Love: The Learner works together in small groups while playing number games.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs)

• Self-esteem: The learner develops self-confidence as the learner successfully recognizes numbers numerals and braille number

symbols.

Link to other activity areas:

• Creative Activities: The learner sings songs on numbers and model numbers

• Language activities: The Learner develops vocabulary when associating spoken words and the number symbols (say the names of
